"65A. Annual transparency report. -(1) The copyright society must draw up and make public a special
report to be referred to as the annual transparency report for each financial year within six months following
the end of that financial year. The copyright society shall publish on its website the annual transparency
report and ensure that the annual transparency report remains available on its website for at least three years.
